text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Umm, pressing down here while...
Yeah, feels pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san!
Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
There's going to be a music contest in the shopping district!
I'm participating too,
so I'm in the middle of intense practice!
choice_data_list: A contest! So you're good at the bass?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
No, actually not at all!
But when I saw the poster calling for challengers,
I just couldn't sit still!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to challenges, the bigger the goal,
the bigger it gets! Ehehe, I'll give it my all~♪

Saying goodbye to her, I stepped outside...
only to find a horse girl
peering into the vocal lesson room.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing.

After that, whenever I happened to catch sight
of Samson Big around the academy...

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... my fingers won't reach~!
Ugh, is it because my hands are too small?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just challenge myself to make them bigger!
First up: hand stretches~!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. To produce a solid sound,
you need to apply proper finger strength—

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~ I definitely have to remember this!
I want everyone to hear a truly big sound, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
"Gonna grow bigger~... grow nice and big~...♪
Heart and body, massively big~...♪"

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Big-senpai! That's amazing,
your playing has gotten so much better than before!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you think so~♪ ...Still,
I shouldn't settle for just this.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I'm aiming for the championship!
To become the champ,
I'm gonna get way, way better~!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
T-The championship?!
That's quite a grand goal... But good luck!

text_block_list.name: Big & Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian-chan!
Huh!? Brian-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, what's up?
Could it be, vocal practice or something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Not really. Just dropping by.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's rare!
...Oh right, Brian-chan,
you learned how to play bass, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm having trouble pressing down
with my pinky finger properly.
Hey, if it's okay, could you teach me a few tips!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Your fingers move so smoothly...!
That's so cool~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're pressing the strings too perpendicular.
...Flatten your fingers a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! You're right!
Changing the angle of my fingers makes it way easier to press!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ......A-Amazing...

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
For Brian-san to go out of her way to teach someone...
This might be the first time I've ever seen it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's because this one actually intends to win.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian-chan!
Thanks for teaching me, I'll do my best~!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Alright, let's do this~!
choice_data_list: You're good friends with Narita Brian, huh?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ah, from the other day!
Ehehe, does it look that way?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Big is having trouble,
she teaches me from time to time!
Brian-chan is really kind, isn't she?♪
choice_data_list: Kind... Yeah, maybe she really is.
If you win, you'll have to thank her.
If you win, you'll have to thank her.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Big is having trouble,
she teaches me from time to time!
Brian-chan is really kind, isn't she?♪
choice_data_list: Kind... Yeah, maybe she really is.
If you win, you'll have to thank her.
If you win, you'll have to thank her.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Right, right!
It might be hard to tell a lot of the time,
but Brian-chan is super thoughtful!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
She even runs alongside me during training!
Thanks to Brian-chan, I feel like Big's
getting way, waaaay bigger!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Definitely!
Since Brian-chan went out of her way to teach me,
I have to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ah! If I get good enough to win,
maybe I can even have a bass showdown with Brian-chan...!
Ehehe, I can't wait~!
